amends: MEM-1 protocol reviewed after MEM-0 freeze
research_positioning: controlled re-evaluation of public memory architectures under a unified fully-local model stack
claim_guardrails: Do not claim exact MemEval numerical reproduction.
Do not claim official LongMemEval GPT-4o accuracy reproduction.
Do not compare Main Track results directly with MemEval README GPT-4.1 numbers.
Published upstream results are external historical coordinates only.

reader_answer_model.endpoint_policy: explicit loopback only; no environment/proxy/provider fallback

memory_system.definition: baseline architecture under comparison: ingestion, storage, retrieval and context construction

embedding_model.query_instruction: Instruct: Given a conversation-history question, retrieve memory passages that provide evidence needed to answer the question\nQuery:
embedding_model.loading: local_files_only=true; no automatic download or fallback

embedding_model_unification: Every dense-compatible baseline receives this same local model through a minimal embedding-client adapter; native memory/retrieval algorithm is unchanged.

reader_runtime.server_binary_policy: fail closed unless exactly one WinGet llama-server.exe matches the frozen version, build and SHA256
reader_runtime.gpu: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4090 Laptop GPU; 16376 MiB

local_execution_constraints.mem0_qdrant_path: run-scoped local directory under the active run artifact
local_execution_constraints.reason: Keep SimpleMem's upstream parallel-window code path while preventing queued local requests against the shared single-slot reader and embedding adapters.

metrics.abstention: question_id.endswith('_abs'); one exact normalized refusal helper is shared by empty-gold token F1 and deterministic abstention_accuracy

tracks.main: controlled re-evaluation of public memory architectures under a unified fully-local model stack; Qwen3-8B reader/internal LLM + Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B CUDA local embedding; deterministic metrics; no hosted API or judge
tracks.native_system_audit: Existing upstream answer heads/prompts, retained only as a runtime/adapter audit; not the primary architecture comparison

context_controlled.answer_head: one shared Qwen3-8B prompt and generation configuration; only ContextBundle content varies

context_token_metrics.context_reader_tokens: Qwen3-8B tokenizer served by pinned llama.cpp /tokenize with add_special=false; applied to serialized shared-reader context
context_token_metrics.context_size_comparisons: Use context_reader_tokens; never assume tokenizer parity

context_controlled.bundle_artifact: context_bundles.jsonl plus per-bundle SHA256 embedded in frozen predictions

context_controlled_one_case_gate.after_completion: STOP; no 10-case, 102-DEV, TEST, M10-Flat or RevMem
context_controlled_one_case_gate.failure_attribution: heuristic hint only; lexical overlap is not causal attribution

optional_local_judge.gate: manual disagreement calibration on the reviewed 10-case diagnostic required before headline use

smoke_gate.after_completion: STOP; do not launch 10-case or 102-DEV run
smoke_gate.after_mem1c: Do not start the 10-case diagnostic until human review. No 102 DEV or TEST before the next approved stage.
